items.title: The Gorenstein property of a morphism of spaces is stable under arbitrary base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a flat locally finite presentation morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S with Gorenstein fibres, the base change of f along any Y' -> Y has Gorenstein fibres again, i.e. the Gorenstein morphism property is fpqc/fppf-stable on the base in the definition's sense. The retained proof is written as a chart reduction: pick etale surjections from schemes V -> Y' and U -> X, form the fibre product scheme covering X x_Y Y', and note the fibre of the pulled-back map is the fibre of a base changed morphism of schemes at a point mapping to the given point; the schemes-side base-change stability of the Gorenstein property (the schemes chapter's result, cited) applies to the chart, and Gorenstein-ness of fibres descends along the etale surjection because it is smooth-local on source and target by the definition section the author references. Retained author proof at lines 6687-6702.
